# module: shellcheck
# case:   base
# vars:
#   EXTRA_ARGS=BASE-EXTRA_ARGS

=== task: install ===
task: "_install:linux" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:macos" finished
task: "_install:macos" started
task: "_install:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "install" finished
task: "install" started
task: [_install:macos] brew install "shellcheck@BASE-VERSION"
task: [_install:macos] echo 'Installing ShellCheck via Homebrew...'
task: [_install:macos] echo 'ShellCheck installed.'
task: status command command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1 && { [ -z "BASE-VERSION" ] || shellcheck --version | grep -Fqx "version: BASE-VERSION"; } exited non-zero: exit status 1

=== task: install:undo ===
task: "_install:undo:linux" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_install:undo:macos" finished
task: "_install:undo:macos" started
task: "_install:undo:windows" not for current platform - ignored
task: "install:undo" finished
task: "install:undo" started
task: [_install:undo:macos] brew uninstall shellcheck
task: [_install:undo:macos] echo 'Removing ShellCheck via Homebrew...'
task: [_install:undo:macos] echo 'ShellCheck removed.'
task: status command ! command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1 exited non-zero: exit status 1

=== task: upgrade ===
task: "_upgrade:linux" not for current platform - ignored
task: "_upgrade:macos" finished
task: "_upgrade:macos" started

=== task: version ===
